annotation_decisions: Strict hierarchy applied: COURSE > MODULE > UNIT > KC.
The three numbered parts 01, 02 and 03 are MODULE nodes.
A child of a MODULE with internal substructure is represented as a UNIT; terminal topics are KC leaves.
Intermediate printed headings such as '1. Les principes généraux' and '2. Les grandes étapes' are retained in heading_path when another graph level would exceed the strict four-level hierarchy.
Pages always mean [start_page, end_page], not a list of individual pages.
The two operational diagrams on pages 11 and 12 are standalone KC leaves.
For the adult protocol, the four-step process is represented and the indicative motif list is decomposed by its printed clinical categories on pages 15–16.
For the pediatric protocol, the decision blocks in the page-17 flowchart are represented as KC leaves.
Cover, sommaire, section-divider and back-cover pages are not forced into KC leaves because they do not introduce instructional knowledge content.
annotation_note: Refined from the prior gold ECG by preserving explicit intermediate instructional headings already evidenced in heading paths, excluding the table of contents as a structural node, and retaining visible subsection labels where available.
